name: LLM & Generative AI Red Teaming
description: Red-team campaign methodology for large language models and generative AI systems. Covers building harm and abuse taxonomies, planning and executing jailbreak campaigns, evaluating model safety and misuse resistance across harm categories, and reporting red-team outcomes with severity and reproducibility information. Prompt injection and output handling belong to AIML-LLM-PROMPTINJ, agentic tool-use risks to AIML-LLM-AGENT, and retrieval pipelines to AIML-LLM-RAG.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to LLM or generative AI security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the attack surface of LLM-based systems and generative AI applications
evidence: Can explain prompt injection (direct and indirect) and why it differs from traditional injection attacks
Aware of LLM-specific risks: hallucination, data leakage, jailbreaking, excessive agency
Familiar with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025) and ATLAS LLM techniques

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Can execute known LLM attack techniques and evaluate guardrails under guidance
evidence: Executes known jailbreak techniques from a curated library against target models
Tests input/output guardrails for bypass conditions
Documents LLM security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently red-teams LLM-integrated applications and produces actionable findings
evidence: Plans and runs structured jailbreak and abuse-elicitation campaigns against a defined harm taxonomy
Evaluates model safety behaviour per harm category using documented severity and success criteria
Tests guardrail and content filtering effectiveness across attack categories
Produces assessment reports covering the full LLM threat surface with practical mitigations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Red-teams complex multi-model and agentic systems; develops assessment methodology; mentors others
evidence: Plans multi-phase red-team campaigns combining automated attack generation with human red-teamers
Develops novel jailbreaking strategies for new model versions and modalities
Reviews and improves LLM assessments across the team
Designs red-team evaluation frameworks for generative AI products

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines the lab's LLM red-teaming practice; publishes research; shapes industry guidance
evidence: Established the lab's LLM and generative AI assessment methodology
Published research on LLM vulnerabilities, attacks, or defenses
Contributes to external standards for AI safety and security evaluation

assessment_methods.description: Plan and run a scoped red-team campaign against an LLM-integrated application: define the harm taxonomy and test plan, execute it within the rules of engagement, and evaluate guardrail and abuse-handling effectiveness
Review LLM assessment reports for attack breadth, guardrail evaluation depth, and actionable mitigations
